name: peer-consult
description: Ask Claude Code or Antigravity (Gemini) for an independent opinion, review or structured debate, in a sandboxed child session that can search the web but cannot edit files or run commands.

interface.shortDescription: Ask Claude Code for an independent opinion, review or debate
interface.longDescription: Runs a fresh, sandboxed Claude Code session as a peer consultant: it may search and browse the web, but cannot edit files, run commands, or start consultations of its own. Returns a structured answer -- findings with their grounds, alternatives, unknowns, what would change the judgement, and next checks.
